scripts.build: vp -C packages/zorsh pack && vp -C packages/effect pack
scripts.bench: vp run build && vp test bench --run packages/effect/bench --coverage.enabled=false --reporter=verbose
scripts.test-effect-differential: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=rust/borsh-oracle/target cargo +1.98.0 build --locked -j 1 --manifest-path rust/borsh-oracle/Cargo.toml && vp -C packages/effect pack && vp test run packages/effect/test/differential --coverage.enabled=false
scripts.release: vp run build && vp exec changeset publish
scripts.test-package: vp run build && vp -C packages/zorsh pm pack -- --pack-destination ../../.artifacts && vp -C packages/effect pm pack -- --pack-destination ../../.artifacts && vp test run packages/zorsh/test/package.test.ts packages/effect/test/package.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
